items.title: Apex Structure — Website, CMS & Backend
items.tagline: The complete web platform for a construction company: public website, admin CMS and backend.
items.summary: Company website, admin CMS and secured backend for Apex Structure, running on AWS with CI/CD.

cover.alt: Apex Structure website and platform cover screenshot

gallery.alt: Apex Structure clients and portfolio screenshot

techStack.reason: EC2, RDS, S3, CloudFront, SES, Route 53, CloudWatch

overview: The complete web platform for Apex Structure, a construction company: the public website, the backend and an admin CMS.
The team manages all content and details through the CMS in real time. I own the platform from design through deployment and maintenance.
purpose: Apex Structure needed a public website and an internal way to manage its content and details, with secure access for different admin roles.
features: Real-time content management through the CMS
Role-based access for super admins and HR users
challenges: Keeping 150+ pages and 180+ APIs secure across different user roles. I used JWT authentication, CSRF protection and role-based access for super admins and HR users.
Making releases fast and safe. I set up the AWS infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines, which cut deployment time by about 40%, to around 15 minutes.
outcome: Deployments cut by about 40%, to around 15 minutes per release.
180+ secured REST APIs serving the website and the CMS.

items.title: Resume Shapeshifter
items.tagline: An AI-powered engine that tailors a resume to a specific job description.
items.summary: AI engine that reads your resume, finds the gaps against a job description and rewrites it to fit.

cover.alt: Resume Shapeshifter AI application cover screenshot

gallery.alt: Resume Shapeshifter resume parsing interface screenshot
Resume Shapeshifter gap analysis report screenshot

overview: Upload a PDF or Word resume and a job description; Resume Shapeshifter finds the gaps between them and rewrites the content to match the role.
It runs Llama 3.3 through Groq's high-speed inference API, with pdf-parse and Mammoth.js for reading files and Zod for validation.
purpose: Tailoring a resume to every job by hand is slow, and it's easy to miss what a job description actually asks for.
features: Multi-dimensional gap analysis against the job
Generates optimised, job-aligned content with Llama 3.3 via Groq
challenges: Reading resumes reliably from different formats: pdf-parse handles PDFs and Mammoth.js handles Word files, so both arrive as clean text before analysis.
Keeping AI output usable: responses are checked with Zod before they reach the page.

items.title: Alpha Way V1
items.tagline: A B2B SaaS platform with a client dashboard and admin modules.
items.summary: B2B SaaS dashboard with a layered Spring Boot backend, 50+ REST APIs and role-based access.

cover.alt: Alpha Way B2B SaaS platform cover screenshot

gallery.alt: Alpha Way destination listings interface screenshot

overview: A B2B dashboard for clients, with admin and operator modules behind role-based permissions.
purpose: The client needed a B2B dashboard where admins and operators each see and act on the right data, delivered on schedule.
features: Role-based permissions for admins and operators
challenges: Coordinating 8+ engineers on one release. I ran sprint planning, task assignment and code reviews in an Agile process.
Keeping frontend and backend in step. We agreed API contracts with the Next.js/TypeScript team and documented every endpoint in Postman.
outcome: Delivered v1 on time with a team of 8+ engineers.
